mentions.name: Aphorio
mentions.description: A fast dashboard for creating web servers, managing Docker containers, server resource management, and transmission testing. It achieves a single socket send speed of 6,000,000 messages per second (5,000,000 round trip) and offers an interactive demo.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Aphorio. It’s a fast dashboard for creating web servers, docker containers, server resource management, and transmission testing.

It now achieves a single socket send speed of 6,000,000 messages per second (5,000,000 round trip). Try out it’s interactive demo.
